entries.title: Psalms 16:1
segments: A Secret Treasure of David. Watch over me, O God; for in You do I put my trust.

entries.title: Psalms 16:2
segments: [Oh my soul,] you have said to the LORD, You [are] my Lord; I have no goodness apart from You.

entries.title: Psalms 16:3
segments: As to the saints in the earth, they [are] the excellent, in whom [is] all my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 16:4
segments: Their sorrows shall be multiplied [who] run after another [god]. I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood; and I will not take their names on my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 16:5
segments: The LORD [is] the portion of my inheritance, and of my cup; You shall uphold my lot.

entries.title: Psalms 16:6
segments: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant [places]; yea, I have a beautiful inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 16:7
segments: I will bless the LORD, who has given me wisdom; my heart also instructs me [in] the nights.

entries.title: Psalms 16:8
segments: I have set the LORD always before Me; because [He is] at My right hand, I shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 16:9
segments: Therefore My heart is glad, and My glory rejoices; My flesh also shall rest in hope;

entries.title: Psalms 16:10
segments: For You will not leave My soul in hell; You will not allow Your Holy One to see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 16:11
segments: You will make Me know the way of life; in Your presence [is] fullness of joys. At Your right hand [are] pleasures forevermore.
